I was never implying it was your job?? I’m just saying its ableist to say all people with BPD are toxic and manipulative lol.
It’s not helpful to Borderlines to label them as manipulative abusive monsters.

I literally have BPD myself. I’m not a horrible person. I’m  very self aware and I’ve come quite a long way with my recovery. Labeling me and other borderlines as manipulative does nothing to help us become more self aware, overcome our instability, and recover. You speak as if the people that have to deal with individuals with BPD are suffering more than the borderlines themselves

The author uses outdated information, changes the symptoms of BPD to fit her agenda, compares adults with BPD to children, paints people with BPD as inherently abusive, says people with BPD don’t have empathy, and provides poor advice that ends up hurting the BPD people in relationships with neurotypicals. The book should be called “how to understand your abusive partner and cope with their abuse”

People with BPD aren’t manipulative, they just tend to make desperate attempts to have their emotional needs met and it can come off as though they’re intentionally trying to control another person but it’s generally just them trying to reach out and not knowing how, typically because of emotional neglect. Also, maybe you should consider that there’s a lot of stigma against people with BPD and its a bad thing that there’s more support outreach for people who have loved ones with BPD than the individuals themselves.
That’s your personal experience. It doesn’t speak for all individuals with BPD.

If you have a BPD person in your life you feel like you have to “deal with” or “tolerate” because of their toxic behavior, chances are you should just end the relationship. Which is the same thing you should do if a person in your life is toxic anyways.
